info.title: UKMA Data
info.description: Every list returns its rows in change-number order, removed rows included. A reader saves one change number per list, asks for `?after=<number>`, stores every page and saves the last page's `cursor` once `hasMore` is false. A bad `after` or `limit` gets 400. New fields may appear in a response without a new version.
